Postgres 17, faster search

Upgrade note: the database moves to Postgres 17.

Back up before upgrading; the migration cannot be undone.

Features

- Search is instant.
- Exports:
  - CSV
  - JSON

    Nested JSON is flattened.

Fixes
- Login no longer loops.

  A second paragraph explaining why it looped.
- Dark mode contrast.

Thanks to everyone who reported bugs.

```
make install
```
